title: Cheat Sheet - raylib
markdown:
## The skeleton

```cpp-norun
#include "raylib.h"
int main()
{
    InitWindow(800, 450, "Game");
    InitAudioDevice();
    SetTargetFPS(60);
    ChangeDirectory(GetApplicationDirectory());
    // load assets here
    while (!WindowShouldClose())
    {
        const float dt = GetFrameTime();
        // update
        BeginDrawing();
        ClearBackground(RAYWHITE);
        // draw
        EndDrawing();
    }
    // unload assets here
    CloseAudioDevice();
    CloseWindow();
}
```

## Window and time

| Function | Does |
|---|---|
| `SetConfigFlags(FLAG_WINDOW_RESIZABLE \| FLAG_VSYNC_HINT \| FLAG_MSAA_4X_HINT)` | Before `InitWindow` |
| `GetScreenWidth()`, `GetScreenHeight()` | Window size |
| `ToggleFullscreen()`, `ToggleBorderlessWindowed()` | Fullscreen modes |
| `GetFrameTime()`, `GetTime()`, `GetFPS()` | Seconds per frame, seconds since start, frames per second |
| `GetRandomValue(min, max)` | Random whole number, both included |

## Input

| Function | True or gives |
|---|---|
| `IsKeyDown(KEY_A)` / `IsKeyPressed` / `IsKeyReleased` | Held / went down / went up |
| `GetCharPressed()` | Next typed character, 0 when none left |
| `GetMousePosition()`, `GetMouseDelta()`, `GetMouseWheelMove()` | Mouse |
| `IsMouseButtonPressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)` | Click |
| `IsGamepadAvailable(0)`, `GetGamepadAxisMovement(0, GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_X)` | Gamepad stick, -1..1 |
| `IsGamepadButtonPressed(0, GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_FACE_DOWN)` | A / Cross |
| `DisableCursor()`, `EnableCursor()` | Lock the mouse for 3D |

## Shapes and text

| Function | Draws |
|---|---|
| `DrawRectangleRec(rect, c)`, `DrawRectangleLinesEx(rect, thick, c)` | Rectangle from its top-left corner |
| `DrawCircleV(centre, r, c)` | Circle from its centre |
| `DrawLineEx(a, b, thick, c)`, `DrawTriangle(a, b, c, colour)` | Line, triangle |
| `DrawText(text, x, y, size, c)`, `MeasureText(text, size)` | Default font |
| `DrawTextEx(font, text, pos, size, spacing, c)`, `MeasureTextEx(...)` | Your font |
| `TextFormat("Score: %d", score)` | printf-style text (do not keep the pointer) |
| `Fade(c, 0.5f)`, `ColorLerp(a, b, t)` | Transparency, mixing |

## Textures

| Function | Does |
|---|---|
| `LoadTexture(path)`, `UnloadTexture(t)` | After InitWindow / before CloseWindow |
| `SetTextureFilter(t, TEXTURE_FILTER_POINT)` | Crisp pixel art |
| `DrawTexturePro(t, src, dest, origin, rotation, tint)` | Part of a texture, scaled, rotated; negative `src.width` flips |
| `LoadRenderTexture(w, h)`, `BeginTextureMode(rt)` ... `EndTextureMode()` | Draw into a texture; draw it with a negative source height |

## Sound

| Function | Does |
|---|---|
| `LoadSound(path)`, `PlaySound(s)`, `LoadSoundAlias(s)` | Short effects; aliases play over each other |
| `SetSoundVolume(s, v)`, `SetSoundPitch(s, p)`, `SetMasterVolume(v)` | Volume 0..1, pitch 1 = normal |
| `LoadMusicStream(path)`, `PlayMusicStream(m)`, `UpdateMusicStream(m)` | Streamed music; update every frame |

## Collision

| Function | Tests |
|---|---|
| `CheckCollisionRecs(a, b)`, `GetCollisionRec(a, b)` | Rectangles, and their overlap |
| `CheckCollisionCircles(c1, r1, c2, r2)`, `CheckCollisionCircleRec(c, r, rect)` | Circles |
| `CheckCollisionPointRec(p, rect)` | Point |
| `CheckCollisionLines(a1, a2, b1, b2, &point)` | Segments |
| `CheckCollisionBoxes(a, b)`, `GetRayCollisionBox(ray, box)` | 3D boxes and rays |

## Cameras

```cpp-norun
Camera2D cam{ /* offset */ { 400, 225 }, /* target */ player, /* rotation */ 0, /* zoom */ 1 };
BeginMode2D(cam); /* world */ EndMode2D();     // then the interface
Vector2 world = GetScreenToWorld2D(GetMousePosition(), cam);

Camera3D cam3{ { 6, 4, 6 }, { 0, 0.5f, 0 }, { 0, 1, 0 }, 45, CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE };
BeginMode3D(cam3); DrawCube({ 0, 0.5f, 0 }, 1, 1, 1, RED); DrawGrid(20, 1); EndMode3D();
Ray ray = GetScreenToWorldRay(GetMousePosition(), cam3);
```

## Shaders

```cpp-norun
Shader sh = LoadShader(nullptr, "effect.fs");               // default vertex shader
int loc = GetShaderLocation(sh, "amount");
SetShaderValue(sh, loc, &amount, SHADER_UNIFORM_FLOAT);
BeginShaderMode(sh); /* draw */ EndShaderMode();
BeginBlendMode(BLEND_ADDITIVE); /* glowing things */ EndBlendMode();
```

## Game maths

| Formula | Use |
|---|---|
| `pos += vel * dt; vel += accel * dt` (velocity first) | Movement |
| `vel *= pow(keepPerSecond, dt)` | Frame-rate independent drag |
| `gravity = 2h / t²`, `jumpSpeed = 2h / t` | A jump of height h rising in t seconds |
| `v - 2 dot(v, n) n` | Bounce off a surface with normal n |
| `(p - target) * zoom + offset` | World to screen (2D camera, no rotation) |
